feed.title: Japan Regulatory Radar
feed.subtitle: English briefs on Japanese digital-asset regulation. Every claim is paired with its Japanese source passage, and a person approves each brief.

entry.title: MUFG firms announce a domestic tokenised-fund experiment
entry.summary: The joint release scheduled a domestic tokenised investment-trust fund for establishment on 31 August 2026 as an experiment.

entry.title: FSA warns Izakaya Limited over unregistered cryptoasset exchange activity
entry.summary: The Financial Services Agency issued a warning to Izakaya Limited in a notice dated 1 September 2026.

entry.title: MUFG announces a JGB repo experiment on Canton Network
entry.summary: MUFG group companies announced collaboration with Digital Asset and Progmat on an experiment for on-chain JGB repo transactions using Canton Network.
